title: runLocalTrackerWebPush
responsibility: Sets up browser notifications on the Tracker hub and reports their state, printing the public key only.

inputs.name: runLocalTrackerWebPush.args
inputs.description: Words after `tracker web-push`: setup --origin <https url> [--rotate], or status [--json].

inputs.name: runLocalTrackerWebPush.config
inputs.description: The native node configuration; only a hub is accepted and its journal folder holds the files.

outputs.name: runLocalTrackerWebPush
outputs.description: Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on a refused or invalid command.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Caught here: bad usage, a spoke, or a different origin without --rotate prints one line and returns 1.
